title: Independent Living Payments Counted on the Entrance Fee Agreement Annual Tax Letter
content:
For the monthly fee portion of the annual tax letter of an **Entrance Fee Agreement**, the independent living payments counted depend on how the year's account was settled: where a payment in the window was returned unpaid, the payments are counted net of the returned payments and net of the returned-payment fees charged in the window; where a payment in the window was made by entrance refund offset and none was returned, the offset payments are left out; otherwise every payment posted in the window counts.

## Records read

The resident's **Independent Living Residency Agreement** ledger within the letter's window: payment entries, returned-payment entries, returned-payment fee charges, and payments whose method is entrance refund offset.

## Condition table

| A payment in the window returned unpaid | A payment in the window made by entrance refund offset | Payments counted |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | Payments less the returned payments less the returned-payment fees |
| No | Yes | Payments less the offset payments |
| No | No | Every payment posted in the window |

## Hypothetical windows

| Payments posted | Returned payments | Returned-payment fees | Offset payments | Counted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 50400.00 | 4200.00 | 35.00 | 0.00 | 46165.00 |
| 50400.00 | 4200.00 | 35.00 | 4200.00 | 46165.00 |
| 50400.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 4200.00 | 46200.00 |
| 50400.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 50400.00 |
